concepts.title: Meaning of Depreciation
concepts.definition: The systematic and permanent reduction in the book value of a tangible fixed asset due to usage, the passage of time, or technological obsolescence.
concepts.key_idea: Allocation of the cost of a fixed asset over its useful life as an expense.

concepts.key_idea: Uniform depreciation charge throughout the asset's life.

concepts.title: Secret Reserve
concepts.definition: A financial reserve that is intentionally omitted from the balance sheet to understate profits or financial strength.
concepts.key_idea: Created by overstating liabilities or understating assets to provide a buffer for lean periods.

concepts.title: Provisions vs Reserves
concepts.definition: Provisions are charges against profit for known liabilities of uncertain amounts; reserves are appropriations of profit to strengthen finances.
concepts.key_idea: Provisions are mandatory expenses; reserves are optional earnings retentions.

solution_steps.explain: If it is for a known liability, it is a provision.
Provisions are deducted before net profit; reserves are taken from net profit.

concepts.title: Provision for Doubtful Debts
concepts.definition: An estimated amount set aside to cover potential losses from debtors who may not pay.
concepts.key_idea: Calculated on the net debtors after deducting unrecorded bad debts.
